[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Get some accountability by sharing goals with a friend or family member.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Reward oneself after reaching exercise goals (e.g., post-workout smoothie).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Be flexible and not too hard on oneself if missing a day or two.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Aim to exercise at the same time every day to make it a habit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Get enough sleep (7-9 hours) to be well-rested for morning exercise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Monitor progress using a journal or habit-tracking app.
